posts.text: Is the Trump administration and DHS deporting U.S. citizens? Maybe not on purpose, but there are documented instances of citizens arrested, detained and processed for deportation before discovering that they were citizens, and even an immigration lawyer who was told to self-deport.  Let’s fact-check @carterking_2025 and his claim that this never happens.

posts.text: President Donald Trump posted an announcement that informed the world that a peace deal with Iran had been reached and Strait of Hormuz would reopen.  The only problem is that the deal isn’t definitive and it basically takes the world exactly where it was before the U.S. and Israel attacked Iran.

posts.text: What is FISA? Speaker of the House Mike Johnson called democratic and Republican lawmakers who voted against extending FISA “shameful”.  To understand how wrong Johnson is, let’s look at what FISA - a law that allows warrantless surveillance - is and how the U.S. government uses it.

posts.text: What’s happening with the Belfast riots? That’s wrong.
